entries.root_cause: the fit rule counts a Mac box total memory, while Metal can only give a model its working set, so small Macs are over-placed

attempts.action: fit rule: m4mini capacity = 11.4 GB (its Metal working set: llama.cpp recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize 12,713 MB, Strata workSet 11.8 GiB) instead of 16 GB; other boxes keep total memory
attempts.rationale: the existing 14.5 GB MiniCPM-V row on m4mini had to run hybrid (32/40 layers) while 10.7 GB files run fully resident, which a 16 GB budget cannot explain and an ~11.4 GB working set does

predicted.note: written with the edit (18:08), before kpi.py first ran but after the round-0 Inkling measurements; predicts C unchanged by the edit and fewer m4mini placements

observed.delta: 0 from this edit (0.26 -> 0.28 came from the Inkling-2-Mini measurements)
observed.note: m4mini Q4_K_M placements drop for every 20-36B candidate; the 8.49 GB Inkling IQ2_XXS file ran resident on m4mini at pp512/tg128, consistent with the cap. Same round: Strata 0.2.19 on m4mini served token id 0 for every reply while its own --bench and --selfcheck passed, so a correctness probe (17 x 23) now gates every published rate.

entries.root_cause: a rate is published on the strength of a throughput instrument that never checks the answer, so a fast wrong engine passes

attempts.action: measurement harness: every published rate must pass, on a server of the same build, a greedy 17x23 probe and a streaming OpenAI tool-call probe with JSON-parsable arguments (flashrsi/local-mind-catalog/toolprobe.py); plus explicit does-not-fit rows for the 7 candidates no box can hold
attempts.rationale: Strata 0.2.19 on the M4 passed its own selfcheck and bench at 28.5 tok/s while every served reply was token id 0; llama-bench alone would have published it

predicted.magnitude: 0.28 -> 0.42 from does-not-fit rows, 0.55-0.65 with the amd395/m1u batches
predicted.note: written in prediction-round1.json at 20:59 before any round-1 measurement; also predicted the probes would reject at least one pair llama-bench would have published

observed.note: C landed inside the predicted range (7 does-not-fit rows, 11 amd395 rows, mlx-serve on m1u and m2max). The second half did not realise: every model that loaded passed both probes; the rows withheld this round were withheld for spread (Mellum, Ornith-9B), missing architectures (Olala, SenseNova) and a box that went unresponsive on an 82 GB load, not by the probes.

entries.root_cause: the fit rule places candidates by params x nominal bpw, which understates real export sizes, so the plan sends models to boxes that cannot hold them

attempts.action: fit rule: place a candidate by its smallest PUBLISHED file (fit.smallest_published, read from the Hugging Face tree) plus KV and 10% headroom; keep a params x 4.5 bpw q4_0 estimate only for the Atlas A2
attempts.rationale: round 1: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash was estimated at 52 GB at ~1.9 bpw, and its smallest real GGUF is 129 GB

predicted.magnitude: 0.64 -> 0.72-0.80; at least 3 candidates move to fits-no-Local-Mind-machine

observed.note: C reached the bottom of the predicted range: Ornith-1.5-35B, Ornith-1.5-9B, Mellum2.1 (m1u) and Ornith-1.5-122B (m2max) covered. The second prediction held: MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, Laguna-M.1 and Ornith-1.5-397B moved from fits-a-128GB-box (estimate) to fits-no-Local-Mind-machine (real files 127-244 GB), and gpt-oss-120b, Nemotron-3-Super and Hy4-flash fit m1u only beside a 40 GB production server, so they were not run. amd395 down all round.
